turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Eyes Without a Face
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's. (Horror, Drama) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Haunting
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. John Markway, an anthropologist with an interest in psychic phenomena, takes two specially selected women to Hill House, a reportedly haunted mansion. Eleanor (Julie Harris), a lonely, eccentric woman with a supernatural event in her past, and the bold Theodora (Claire Bloom), who has ESP, join John and the mansion's heir, cynical Luke (Russ Tamblyn). They are immediately overwhelmed by strange sounds and events, and Eleanor comes to believe the house is alive and speaking directly to her. (Horror) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Curse of the Demon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: American professor John Holden arrives in London for a conference on parapsychology only to discover that the colleague he was supposed to meet was killed in a freak accident the day before. It turns out that the deceased had been investigating a cult led by Dr. Julian Karswell. Though a skeptic, Holden is suspicious of the devil-worshiping Karswell. Following a trail of mysterious manuscripts, Holden enters a world that makes him question his faith in science. (Horror) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Vincent Price: What Keeps Us Alive
The Fly
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: House of Wax
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wax sculptor Henry (Vincent Price) is horrified to learn that his business partner, Matthew (Roy Roberts), plans on torching their wax museum to collect on the insurance policy. Henry miraculously survives a fiery confrontation with Matthew and re-emerges some years hence with a museum of his own. But when the appearance of Henry's new wax sculptures occurs at the same time that a number of corpses vanish from the city morgue, art student Sue Allen (Phyllis Kirk) begins suspecting wrongdoing. (Horror) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: House on Haunted Hill
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rich oddball Frederick Loren has a proposal for five guests at a possibly haunted mansion: show up, survive a night filled with scares and receive $10,000 each. The guest of honor is Loren's estranged wife, Annabelle, who, with her secret lover, Dr. Trent, has concocted her own scheme to scare Loren's associate, Nora Manning, into shooting the potentially crazy millionaire. However, more spooks and shocks throw a wrench into the plan. (Horror) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mad Magician
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An 1880s magician (Vincent Price) creates illusions of mayhem that work. (Horror) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Tingler
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Warren Chapin (Vincent Price) has made a surprising discovery -- the spine-chilling sensation that people get when scared is due to a parasite that he dubs the "tingler." Chapin concludes that in extreme circumstances, prolonged fear can cause the creature to damage a person's spine and even cause death if the victim can't scream, a theory that Oliver Higgins (Philip Coolidge) uses to deadly effect on his wife (Judith Evelyn). Soon the tingler that killed the woman is on the loose. (Horror) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A killer called the Bat has claimed many lives in the small town inhabited by novelist Cornelia van Gorder (Agnes Moorehead) and her maid, Lizzie (Lenita Lane). As Cornelia implores Dr. Malcolm Wells (Vincent Price) to help her ailing maid, $1 million in the town's bank goes missing. With greed and fear reaching new heights, police Lt. Andy Anderson (Gavin Gordon) goes to Cornelia's house to investigate additional murders committed by the Bat. (Mystery, Thriller) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Hypnotic Eye
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A stage hypnotist's (Jacques Bergerac) ugly helper (Allison Hayes) suggests terrible things to spellbound beauties. (Horror) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Doctor X
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: New York City reporter Lee Taylor (Lee Tracy) is doing a piece on a series of grisly, cannibalistic murders that have all been committed under a full moon. Police soon begin to suspect that the murderer works at the lab of Dr. Jerry Xavier (Lionel Atwill), a mysterious Long Island researcher who is doing an investigation of his own. Antsy for an inside story, Taylor breaks into the lab, where he meets and falls in love with Dr. Xavier's daughter Joan (Fay Wray). (Horror) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mystery of the Wax Museum
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ivan Igor (Lionel Atwill) is the sculptor at a famous wax museum in London. When his partner, Joe Worth (Edwin Maxwell), burns down the museum for the insurance money, Igor is trapped inside. Years later he re-emerges in New York as the curator of a new wax museum, which boasts incredibly lifelike statues. When model Joan Gale (Monica Bannister) goes missing, however, reporter Florence Dempsey (Glenda Farrell) follows the clues to Igor's museum, where she discovers a terrible secret. (Horror) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Transylvania 6-5000
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two tabloid reporters (Jeff Goldblum, Ed Begley Jr.) go to a strange land to check on rumors of monsters running amok. (Comedy) - 1985

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes: A-Haunting We Will Go
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Daffy Duck's nephew goes trick-or-treating on Halloween, but he gets a fright when visiting Witch Hazel's house. (Animated, Children, Special, Comedy) - 1966-04-16

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pufnstuf
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A boy (Jack Wild) enters a dragon's magic land, hounded by a witch who wants to steal his golden, diamond-studded flute. (Children, Fantasy) - 1970

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dracula
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust. (Horror) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mummy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor. (Horror) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Testing his theory that in every man dwells a good and an evil force, the reserved Dr. Jekyll (Fredric March) develops a formula that separates the two, turning him into a violent ruffian named Mr. Hyde. Thinking he has found the answer to one of life's grandest mysteries, Dr. Jekyll soon realizes he is becoming addicted to his darker self as he unleashes his violent side on earthy dance hall girl Ivy (Miriam Hopkins) and fights Hyde to regain control of his body. (Horror) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bride of Frankenstein
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After recovering from injuries sustained in the mob attack upon himself and his creation, Dr. Frankenstein (Colin Clive) falls under the control of his former mentor, Dr. Pretorius (Ernest Thesiger), who insists the now-chastened doctor resume his experiments in creating new life. Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control. (Horror) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dracula
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target. (Horror, Drama, Romance) - 1979

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Phantom of the Paradise
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After record producer Swan (Paul Williams) steals the music of songwriter Winslow Leach (William Finley) and gives it to one of his bands, Leach sneaks into Swan's offices. Catching Leach, Swan frames him for dealing drugs, which lands him in prison. After Leach breaks out and again attempts to sabotage Swan's empire, an accident crushes his face. Leach then dons a costume and becomes the Phantom, intent on ruining Swan while saving singer Phoenix (Jessica Harper) from a terrible fate. (Musical comedy) - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cat People
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Irena Dubrovna (Simone Simon), a New York City–based fashion designer who hails from Serbia, begins a romance with marine engineer Oliver Reed (Kent Smith). After the couple gets married, Oliver becomes concerned about Irena's notion that she is cursed and may transform into a large cat in the heat of passion. Confiding in his beautiful assistant, Alice Moore (Jane Randolph), about his marital issues, Oliver unwittingly triggers Irena's curse, with tragic results. (Horror) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Seventh Victim
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After young Mary Gibson (Kim Hunter) discovers that her older sister Jacqueline (Jean Brooks) has disappeared, she leaves her boarding school and heads to New York City to track down her sibling. Arriving at Jacqueline's apartment, Mary finds ominous signs of trouble, with her sister nowhere in sight. Aided by psychiatrist Dr. Louis Judd (Tom Conway) and others, Mary gets drawn deeper into the mystery, and evidence begins to point to the involvement of a sinister cult. (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Leopard Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Latin dancer Clo-Clo (Margo) begins to overshadow nightclub singer Kiki Walker (Jean Brooks), Kiki's agent, Jerry Manning (Dennis O'Keefe), decides to spice up his client's act with an enormous black leopard on a leash. But the big cat escapes from the club -- and soon after, a young girl (Margaret Landry) and others are found dead around their small town. When evidence suggests that the killer may be human, suspicion falls on the leopard's Native American owner (Abner Biberman). (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States. (Horror) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Eye of the Devil
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A French winegrower (David Niven) returns to Bordeaux with his wife (Deborah Kerr) and family to face ritual sacrifice for another bad year. (Horror) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blithe Spirit
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Skeptical novelist Charles Condomine (Rex Harrison) invites self-proclaimed medium Madame Arcati (Margaret Rutherford) to his home for a séance, hoping to gather material for a new book. When the hapless psychic accidentally summons the spirit of Condomine's late wife, Elvira (Kay Hammond), his home and life are quickly turned into a shambles as his wife's ghost torments both himself and his new bride, Ruth (Constance Cummings). David Lean directed this adaptation of Noel Coward's hit play. (Fantasy) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cat People
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Irena Dubrovna (Simone Simon), a New York City–based fashion designer who hails from Serbia, begins a romance with marine engineer Oliver Reed (Kent Smith). After the couple gets married, Oliver becomes concerned about Irena's notion that she is cursed and may transform into a large cat in the heat of passion. Confiding in his beautiful assistant, Alice Moore (Jane Randolph), about his marital issues, Oliver unwittingly triggers Irena's curse, with tragic results. (Horror) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Seventh Victim
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After young Mary Gibson (Kim Hunter) discovers that her older sister Jacqueline (Jean Brooks) has disappeared, she leaves her boarding school and heads to New York City to track down her sibling. Arriving at Jacqueline's apartment, Mary finds ominous signs of trouble, with her sister nowhere in sight. Aided by psychiatrist Dr. Louis Judd (Tom Conway) and others, Mary gets drawn deeper into the mystery, and evidence begins to point to the involvement of a sinister cult. (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Leopard Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Latin dancer Clo-Clo (Margo) begins to overshadow nightclub singer Kiki Walker (Jean Brooks), Kiki's agent, Jerry Manning (Dennis O'Keefe), decides to spice up his client's act with an enormous black leopard on a leash. But the big cat escapes from the club -- and soon after, a young girl (Margaret Landry) and others are found dead around their small town. When evidence suggests that the killer may be human, suspicion falls on the leopard's Native American owner (Abner Biberman). (Horror) - 1943

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E6 The Invisible Enemy: Part 2 As the Doctor's condition worsens, he instructs Leela to pilot the TARDIS to the Bi-Al Foundation. The only chance of curing the Doctor is to literally get inside his head.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E7 The Invisible Enemy: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela have been cloned and miniaturised and injected into the Doctor's body. There they must fight the virus on a microscopic level before time runs out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E8 The Invisible Enemy: Part 4 The Nucleus has escaped the Doctor's body and grown to human size. Its plans to spawn and infect the whole galaxy are nearing fruition. And it looks like K-9 has a new master….

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E9 Image of the Fendahl: Part 1 The Doctor and Leela arrive in present day England at Fetch Priory where a mysterious skull that is older than mankind is exerting a deadly influence on those around it.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E10 Image of the Fendahl: Part 2 As Thea succumbs to the power of the skull, the Doctor realises that an ancient horror from the mythology of his own people is manifesting at Fetch Priory.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E11 Image of the Fendahl: Part 3 Stahl intends to control the power of the Fendahl for himself. The Doctor and Leela take a trip in the TARDIS to discover the truth about the ancient evil from the dawn of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E12 Image of the Fendahl: Part 4 Thea has become the Fendahl Core and Stahl realises that he is out of his depth as his followers transform into the hideous, snake-like Fendahleen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E12 Image of the Fendahl: Part 4 Thea has become the Fendahl Core and Stahl realises that he is out of his depth as his followers transform into the hideous, snake-like Fendahleen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E13 The Sun Makers: Part 1 The TARDIS arrives on Pluto which has been made habitable and turned into a giant factory where the ruthless Company exploits its under-paid workers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E14 The Sun Makers: Part 2 The Doctor is taken prisoner by the Gatherer and sent to the Correction Centre. Leela mounts a rescue attempt, but the Gatherer’s men are waiting.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E15 The Sun Makers: Part 3 The Doctor is free but Leela has been captured by the Gatherer and is sentenced to a grisly death by public steaming.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E16 The Sun Makers: Part 4 The Others launch a full-scale uprising against the Gatherer and his Inner Retinue while the Doctor confronts the real head of the Company.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E17 Underworld: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on a spaceship which is crewed by the survivors of the planet Minyos who are on a quest to find the lost ship, the P7E. Their journey has taken them 100,000 years.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E18 Underworld: Part 2 When their ship crashes beneath the surface of a newly formed planet, the Minyan survivors discover what they have been searching for. But their arrival is not welcomed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E19 Underworld: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela attempt to penetrate the Citadel of the Seers to rescue Idas’s father who has been sentenced to death.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E20 Underworld: Part 4 The Minyans are eager to recover the race banks that they have waited so long to find, but the Doctor becomes suspicious when the Oracle simply allows Jackson to take them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E21 The Invasion of Time: Part 1 Leela is concerned by the Doctor’s strange behaviour when, after a secret meeting with aliens, he returns to Gallifrey and abruptly stakes his claim on the Time Lord presidency.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E22 The Invasion of Time: Part 2 The Doctor is made president of the Time Lords and immediately orders K9 to lower the planet’s defences and has Leela banished to the wilderness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E23 The Invasion of Time: Part 3 The Doctor has betrayed his own people and enabled a Vardan invasion of Gallifrey. Leela joins forces with the Outsiders and prepares to strike back against the aliens.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E24 The Invasion of Time: Part 4 As the Vardans finally fully materialise on Gallifrey, the Doctor prepares to spring his trap. But does a more deadly alien force lie behind the Vardans?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E25 The Invasion of Time: Part 5 The Sontarans have taken control of the Capital on Gallifrey and intend to use the power of the Time Lords to rampage through all of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E26 The Invasion of Time: Part 6 Stor, the Sontaran leader, finally gains access to the TARDIS in search of the Great Key of Rassilon and a dangerous game of hide and seek begins inside the Doctor’s ship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E1 The Ribos Operation: Part 1 On a mission to collect the six segments of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Ribos where the first segment is protected by the monstrous Shrivenzale.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E2 The Ribos Operation: Part 2 Garron is attempting to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos, but the jethrik that is vital to his plan is really the first segment of the Key to Time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S25 E39 Something to Remember On the last day of Yong Bao's visit to Sodor, his friends dig up a giant keepsake to help him remember them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E7 Can We Have Our Ball Back? In this episode the Numberblocks learn to make 3D shapes using 2D shapes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E6 My Lettuce Monsieur LaFleur has grown his first ever head of lettuce! He drives very slowly to deliver it to town, too slowly in fact, Pants fears he may never make it to Peppermint's grocery store on time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fantus And The Kitchen Gadgets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Hand Mixers Fantus learns about hand mixers. He sees how you can use one to whip cream.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Episode 13 It's a Halloween Party! Join The Wiggles as they prepare for the big party by singing, dancing, and making toffee apples!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E20 Pumpkin Peril It's the night before Halloween and Bitzer is charged with guarding the Farmer's 3 prize pumpkins. Despite Shaun and the flock's best efforts, the pumpkins mysteriously disappear, leaving nothing but a trail of ghostly slime.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Adventures of Paddington
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E37 Paddington and the Cursed Halloween Show It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their special spooky play?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E19 Night of the Goblins Green Goblin's clones threaten to ruin Halloween.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E13 Monstertato Evil Pea creates her own evil version of her nemesis, Supertato. With the help of her laboratory and her Hench-Cobs, Evil Pea makes a big, green lumbering Spud that she names Monstertato!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E12 Super Spooky House/ Pumpkin Ball The Kitties face their fears and enter the Super Spooky House. When the Pumpkin Ball is stolen, it's up to the SuperKitties to get it back in time for the Halloween Party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E38 The Witch Competition A young witch is planning on moving into Mrs Witch's house. Mrs Witch has to come out of retirement to keep her place in the Little Kingdom.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Oogga Sugga Flower rediscovers her magical Oogga Sugga straw and tries it out on Dad, but it breaks! With Flour's help, she repairs it, finally spreading Oogga Sugga fun to Dirk, Penny, and even herself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E34 Fish N Ships When the aquarium is closed, Flower, Louie Louis, and Unicorn Cuzzy make their own fun, turning a cardboard box into a submarine on a quest to find the elusive albino sea lion pup.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E7 Pumpkin Competition Halloween is here and everyone is gathering their pumpkins for the pumpkin competition.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Fancy Dress Party Peppa and George are having a fancy dress party. Peppa is dressed as a fairy princess and George is a scary dinosaur. Peppa has to judge the best costume and finds it quite difficult not to pick herself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Butterflies Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Yoga Ball Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E7 Tricks and Treats Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes have their plans thwarted when a large Pumpkinsaurus blocks their way into the Spooky Forest.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Popcorn When a young Cornasaurolophus strays from its herd and befriends Ginger and the Peas, all is fine until it starts popping which draws attention of the Bananaraptors!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Pay Attention Pearl Pearl is sure Mara has Flailing Tail but when purple spots appear on other patients, Zog and Gadabout suspect there's something afoot. Will Pearl listen to them?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E27 The Spooky Badge The Squirrels are playing dress-up when they hear a ghostly sound. They go to investigate and come across white powdery footprints and spot a floating sheet. Can Duggee and the squirrels get to the bottom of this spooky tale?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 I'm Hungry King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, Norrie has her hair cut, the Squirrels tell us their favourite food, and we learn a bit about Nigel.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 Sandwich Fizzy and Suds explore the art of sandwich making from Banh Mi to BBQs, watch a sandy animation, and practice the creative art of layering.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Play School: The Not Too Spooky Special Join Eddie, Rachael and Matt for The Not Too Spooky Special! They'll be sharing spooky stories, wearing spooky costumes and making a spooky potion - but not too spooky! It will be spooktacular!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders ᴺᵉʷ

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 The Mysterious Island / Mystery of the Vam-Pirates On Halloween night, Santiago and his crew must retrieve the legendary Treasure Treats from La Isla Misteriosa. / Santiago encounters a real-life vampire! The two must team up to rescue their crews.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters Save Halloween

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran ᴺᵉʷ

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and friends ᴺᵉʷ

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Born Psychopath

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 The Importance Of Cheese Sophie visits a local cheese maker to see how they age their cheeses in caves and stuffs courgette flowers with local ricotta. She is also shown how to make the cakes known locally as nun's breasts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Neville Poelina: Orange Duck & Curry Bush Turkey Neville Poelina will show us how to make two delicious dishes with duck and bush turkey - making the most out of his outdoor forty-four gallon homemade bush oven.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Cooking With Kids School Holidays mean finding things for the kids to do and Maggie and Simon get some kids busy looking for mushrooms and picking plums. Simon also visits a Mussel farm in Port Lincoln.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E25 Episode 25 Laura is joined by nutritionist Cassie Lawless to make delicious and healthy Thai Coconut Chicken Meatballs in the beautiful McLaren Vale region of South Australia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E25 Getting Figgy With It: Chicken And Fig Rachael is joined by her husband, John, and her sister, Maria, as she shows how to prepare a Chicken and Fig dish featured on their wedding menu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Manly Dam Manly Dam is one of Hayden's favourite spots for a BBQ, and Hayden cooks up a storm with dishes featuring chicken drumsticks, wood-roasted salmon, and leg of lamb.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E20 Episode 20 Laura has an early start in the market as she makes her cheesy Chorizo Lasagne, before she assembles the go-to dish when you need to clean out your fridge, her delicious Frittata.

ksby.us.description: While dangerous, extreme weather makes for some riveting video and lends itself to being easily shared online and going viral. Such videos of destructive weather are featured on this series, which showcases the weather footage in addition to featuring first-hand accounts of survivors who lived through the treacherous conditions. On-air meteorologists also share their tales of being on the front lines and experiencing the fury that Mother Nature sends their way, sometimes even becoming the story themselves. ksby.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
ksby.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series. (Crime, Reality, Weather) - 2018-10-07

kabb.us.title: The 1% Club
kabb.us.description: The "1% Club" is a unique, compelling and funny game show that tests the nation's intelligence, based on a scientific survey. This entertainment format is not about what one knows, it's more about how one thinks. Saboteur
